kelly: small spike of 503s on /v1/embeddings eu-west1 since 10:14. Root cause points to KV eviction race on embed-runtime v2.3.0. I built hotfix image embed:v2.3.2-pin. Requesting expedited push to Dedicated eu pool; prefer micro-canary (1 node, 3m) but can bypass if ops insists.
rio: agree on micro-canary. what's rollback plan?
anika: artifact: gs://redwood-builds/embeddings/zz99.tar.gz. Staging smoke+integration green. Rollback is single-image revert and KV flush. Will paste commands.
kelly: @deploybot run preflight and flag blockers.
deploybot: preflight -> smoke: PASS; infra-checks: PASS; canary-tests: RECOMMENDED; migrations: NONE; open-PRs: 0. Interactive approvals required: ops + product. React with :thumbsup: within 8m to approve micro-canary.
opsbot: oncall here. +1 for micro-canary. need exact rollback commands and a kill-switch.
anika: rollback commands (ops-tested):
```
kubectl -n inference set image deployment/embed-service embed=redwood/embed:v2.3.0
./scripts/flush-kv.sh --cluster eu-west1 --service embed-service --confirm
```
kill-switch: abort via `deploybot cancel <deploy_id>` and run rollback above. Abort conditions: error_rate > 1% or p95 > 2.5x baseline during canary.
rio: :thumbsup: (ops)
kelly: product signoff DM from anika: "ok to micro-canary, notify if any customer impact" 94 posting for audit.
kelly: approved. triggering deploy id deploy_1830002222_mini. Canary 1 node for 3m -> staged roll to 5 nodes.
deploybot: deploy triggered by kelly. Canary node updating... health checks PASS. Waiting 3m.
# +3m
opsbot: canary metrics stable. no OOMs, redis-ejects normalizing. green to proceed.
deploybot: rolling remaining nodes: 5/5 updated. post-deploy smoke: PASS. traffic shifted to new image over 90s. monitoring window 10m.
kelly: monitoring dashboards: embeds-errors, p95-latency, redis-ejects. if regressions run rollback above and notify #incidents.
rio: +6m: metrics look stable. error-rate back to baseline.
kelly: updating changelog and notifying support. thanks for quick sync :rocket:
